newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee futures off peaks, still sharply up.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee futures off peaks, still sharply up.

text.p: LIFFE robusta coffee futures rallied sharply in hectic trading on strong Monday New York gains although they ended the Tuesday morning session off their highs.
"What we are seeing here is genuine good short-covering," he said. "New York is making substantial news."
The market was due to open a hefty $70-$100 a tonne higher which was mostly fulfilled.
By the close, March was $79 up at $1,459 a tonne after reaching a high of $1,473, the best since last September.
Traders said the advance triggered fund stop buying in the $1,460 area, which then pushed values passed the $1,470 mark.
Origin sellers were mostly sidelined, awaiting higher values.
New York arabica futures surged on Monday on constructive technical indicators, a Colombian port strike and the prospect of a smaller Brazilian harvest.
London's market also found further strength on Monday on news Vietnam was considering joining the producer-only group's export programme.
But Vietnamese industry officials said on Tuesday that Vietnam would face financial difficulties in meeting the group's export plan.
Midday volume was an impressive 8,205 lots. -- Jalil Hamid, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4985
